status: Experimental design specified; no eligible experimental dataset and no bench execution
biological_novelty: Withdrawal-associated AT1-marker recovery has published precedent. The discriminating extension is fibroblast-restricted reception during the resolution phase, plus independent lineage yield; not a claim to newly discover withdrawal recovery.

precedent.schedule: 14 days IL1B exposure then 7 days without added IL1B

model: Same-species lineage-labelled adult AT2 plus defined fibroblast co-culture, with culture conditions and all added ligands recorded
unit: Independent biological preparation with source-animal/donor identities; aliquot wells are technical subsamples. Shared parent sources across preparations must be modelled or aggregated at that parent level.
allocation: Block all six arms within independent preparation; randomize well positions and process/score blind to arm. Fibroblast-restricted intervention is assigned after the common entry phase.

arms.endpoint: day 21 mature traced yield plus survival

primary_outcome.measure: Viable traced descendants satisfying a fixed late-AT1 protein/morphology gate per 1000 initially labelled epithelial input cells at day21
primary_outcome.gate: AGER and late AT1 CAV1 protein with compatible flattened morphology, externally validated positive/negative controls; PDPN or HOPX alone is insufficient
primary_outcome.missingness: Report lost/unreadable cultures and surviving traced counts by arm. Never impute missing mature yield as zero without observed absence.
primary_outcome.qualification: Lineage contribution, not independently measured whole-lung or barrier function

contrasts.question: Does the specified withdrawal schedule change later mature contribution?
Does fibroblast reception during resolution modify the schedule effect?

secondary: day14 entry-state and viability in prespecified sibling aliquots
measured soluble exposure and receptor engagement
gates: verified cytokine withdrawal, including carryover/endogenous supply checks appropriate to the claim
fibroblast-restricted intervention with measured onset after entry, epithelial IL1R1 intact and engagement assessed
adequate viability/dynamic range and late-AT1 positive controls
independent-unit precision justification and frozen inference/multiplicity before main endpoints
label lineage retention and independent late phenotype thresholds
inference_plan: Equal-independent-unit contrasts; technical wells averaged within unit. C1 and C2 are a two-test family with Holm control if both are tested inferentially. Fix interval/error model and sample size using independent or blinded planning data before main endpoint comparison.
limits: C1 is a specified exposure-schedule effect, not pure duration separated from dose and recency
Constitutive fibroblast deletion confounds entry and resolution; it does not substitute for this design
A decrease in transitional RNA or improved survival alone does not establish mature yield or function
C2 does not identify a downstream ligand or establish malignant transformation

dose/exposure measurements and endpoint operating thresholds
